name: Tidewater Midstream and Infrastructure Ltd.
summary: Tidewater Midstream and Infrastructure Ltd. operates as a downstream, midstream, and infrastructure company in Western Canada and the United States. It primarily focuses on processing natural gas, natural gas liquids (NGLs), crude oil, refined products, and renewable products and services, as well as refining of light oil. The company also engages in the sale of refined products, including low sulfur diesel, renewable diesel, and gasoline; natural gas, NGL extraction, as well as renewable fuels and emissions credits; and purchases, transports, sells, stores and blends both NGLs and crude oil. The company was incorporated in 2015 and is headquartered in Calgary, Canada.
